#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed CTest selection; CLI prints a plan and never executes tests."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

from cpu_gpu_protocol import ROOT, dump_new, require, sha, source_manifest
from cpu_gpu_provenance import strict_json, validate_digest_map
from ctest_build_guard import validate_build_tree

MANIFEST = ROOT / 'docs/NON_TIMING_TEST_SELECTION_v1.json'
SAFE_CLASSES = {'cpu_correctness', 'gpu_correctness'}
CLASSES = SAFE_CLASSES | {'timing'}
# Fixtures/dependencies can implicitly schedule tests outside an -R expression.
SAFE_PROPERTIES = {'WORKING_DIRECTORY', 'TIMEOUT', 'SKIP_RETURN_CODE', 'LABELS'}
TIMING_ENTRY_POINTS = {'test_experiments.py', 'test_structure_timing', 'test_structure_benchmark.py',
    'test_search_timing', 'test_search_benchmark.py', 'test_timing', 'test_benchmark.py',
    'test_parallel_mergesort', 'test_parallel_benchmark.py', 'test_comparison'}


def load_manifest():
    manifest = strict_json(MANIFEST.read_text())
    require(isinstance(manifest, dict) and type(manifest.get('schema_version')) is int and
            manifest['schema_version'] == 1 and manifest.get('policy') == 'non_timing_correctness_v1',
            'invalid non-timing manifest')
    hashes = manifest.get('reviewed_source_sha256')
    validate_digest_map(hashes, 'reviewed non-timing source snapshot')
    require(hashes == source_manifest(), 'non-timing source snapshot changed; review and reclassify before execution')
    tests = manifest.get('tests')
    require(isinstance(tests, dict) and bool(tests), 'missing test classifications')
    for name, entry in tests.items():
        require(isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch('[a-z_]+', name) and isinstance(entry, dict),
                'invalid test classification')
        require(entry.get('classification') in CLASSES and isinstance(entry.get('reason'), str) and entry['reason'],
                'unclassified test: ' + name)
        require(isinstance(entry.get('command'), list) and bool(entry['command']) and
                all(isinstance(a, str) and a for a in entry['command']), 'missing reviewed command: ' + name)
    cpu = manifest.get('cpu_build_tests'); gpu = manifest.get('cuda_additional_tests')
    require(isinstance(cpu, list) and isinstance(gpu, list) and cpu and gpu and
            all(isinstance(n, str) for n in cpu + gpu) and len(set(cpu + gpu)) == len(cpu + gpu) and
            set(cpu + gpu) == set(tests), 'invalid discovery coverage manifest')
    return manifest


def expected_command(pattern, build_dir):
    result = []
    for token in pattern:
        if token == '@python':
            result.append(str(Path(sys.executable).resolve()))
        elif token == '@build':
            result.append(str(build_dir.resolve()))
        elif token == '@source':
            result.append(str(ROOT.resolve()))
        elif token.startswith('@build/'):
            relative = token[len('@build/'):]
            require(Path(relative).name == relative and relative not in ['.', '..'], 'unsafe reviewed binary')
            result.append(str((build_dir / relative).resolve()))
        elif token.startswith('@source/'):
            relative = token[len('@source/'):]
            require(not Path(relative).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(relative).parts, 'unsafe reviewed source')
            result.append(str((ROOT / relative).resolve()))
        else:
            raise ValueError('unreviewed command token: ' + token)
    return result


def pre_discovery_gate(build_dir):
    """Shared static gate; never invokes CTest or evaluates CMake code."""
    manifest = load_manifest()
    return manifest, validate_build_tree(build_dir, manifest, expected_command)


def select_tests(discovery, build_dir, allow_gpu=False):
    manifest, guard = pre_discovery_gate(build_dir)
    build_dir = Path(guard['build_dir'])
    require(isinstance(discovery, dict) and discovery.get('kind') == 'ctestInfo' and
            discovery.get('version') == {'major': 1, 'minor': 0} and isinstance(discovery.get('tests'), list),
            'invalid CTest JSON discovery')
    tests = discovery['tests']; names = [t.get('name') if isinstance(t, dict) else None for t in tests]
    require(all(isinstance(n, str) for n in names) and len(set(names)) == len(names), 'duplicate/malformed discovered tests')
    expected_cpu = set(manifest['cpu_build_tests']); expected_gpu = set(manifest['cuda_additional_tests'])
    require(set(names) in [expected_cpu, expected_cpu | expected_gpu], 'unknown/missing/unclassified discovered tests')
    require(set(names) == set(guard['test_names']), 'discovery differs from guarded registry coverage')
    if allow_gpu:
        require(set(names) == expected_cpu | expected_gpu, 'GPU correctness requested from non-CUDA build')
    selected, excluded = [], []
    for test in tests:
        name = test['name']; entry = manifest['tests'][name]; classification = entry['classification']
        command = test.get('command')
        require(isinstance(command, list) and all(isinstance(a, str) for a in command) and
                [str(Path(a).resolve()) for a in command] ==
                [str(Path(a).resolve()) for a in guard['commands'][name]],
                'discovery differs from guarded registry: ' + name)
        if classification == 'timing' or (classification == 'gpu_correctness' and not allow_gpu):
            excluded.append(dict(name=name, classification=classification, reason=entry['reason']))
            continue
        command = test.get('command')
        require(isinstance(command, list) and all(isinstance(a, str) for a in command), 'missing discovered command: ' + name)
        entry_points = {Path(a).name for a in command}
        require(not (entry_points & TIMING_ENTRY_POINTS) and
                not ('test_cuda_benchmark.py' in entry_points and len(command) != 2),
                'timing entry point cannot be selected: ' + name)
        require([str(Path(a).resolve()) for a in command] == expected_command(entry['command'], build_dir),
                'unreviewed CTest command/arguments: ' + name)
        properties = test.get('properties', [])
        require(isinstance(properties, list) and all(isinstance(p, dict) and p.get('name') in SAFE_PROPERTIES
                for p in properties), 'unsafe/unreviewed CTest properties: ' + name)
        require(len({p['name'] for p in properties}) == len(properties), 'duplicate discovered property: ' + name)
        expected_properties = guard['properties'][name]
        for prop in properties:
            key, value = prop['name'], prop.get('value')
            if key == 'WORKING_DIRECTORY':
                require(value == str(build_dir), 'unreviewed discovery working directory: ' + name)
            elif key in ['TIMEOUT', 'SKIP_RETURN_CODE']:
                require(key in expected_properties and value == int(expected_properties[key]),
                        'unreviewed discovery numeric property: ' + name)
            else:
                raise ValueError('unreviewed discovered property: ' + key)
        selected.append(name)
    require(bool(selected), 'empty non-timing selection')
    expression = '^(' + '|'.join(re.escape(n) for n in sorted(selected)) + ')$'
    argv = ['ctest', '--test-dir', str(build_dir), '--output-on-failure', '-V', '--parallel', '1', '-R', expression]
    return dict(schema_version=1, policy=manifest['policy'], manifest_sha256=sha(MANIFEST),
                allow_gpu_correctness=allow_gpu, selected=sorted(selected), excluded=excluded,
                discovered_count=len(tests), selected_count=len(selected), ctest_argv=argv,
                build_metadata=guard,
                tests_executed=False, full_protocol_prerequisites=False)


def selected_ctest(call, output, name, build_dir, allow_gpu=False, prefix=None):
    """Discover and save the exact safe selection before the caller executes it."""
    require(list(prefix or []) in [[],
        ['env', '-u', 'ASAN_OPTIONS', '-u', 'LSAN_OPTIONS', 'UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1'],
        ['env', 'ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0', 'UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1']], 'unreviewed CTest wrapper')
    _, guarded = pre_discovery_gate(build_dir)
    # Retain the exact checked identity; the callback may use a different cwd.
    build_dir = Path(guarded['build_dir'])
    discovery = call(name + '_discovery', ['ctest', '--test-dir', str(build_dir), '-N', '--show-only=json-v1'], 60)
    require(discovery.get('exit_code', 0) == 0, 'CTest discovery failed')
    plan = select_tests(strict_json(discovery['stdout']), build_dir, allow_gpu)
    require(plan['build_metadata'] == guarded, 'build metadata changed during discovery')
    dump_new(output / (name + '_selection.json'), plan)
    # Repeat source AND generated-metadata checks at the execution boundary.
    _, final_guard = pre_discovery_gate(build_dir)
    require(final_guard == guarded, 'build metadata changed before execution')
    result = call(name, list(prefix or []) + plan['ctest_argv'], 900)
    require(re.search(r'0 tests failed out of ' + str(plan['selected_count']) + r'(?:\s|$)', result['stdout']) and
            '***Skipped' not in result['stdout'], 'non-timing correctness coverage failed/skipped')
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, allow_abbrev=False)
    parser.add_argument('--build-dir', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--discovery-json', type=Path, help='Read retained discovery without invoking CTest')
    parser.add_argument('--allow-gpu-correctness', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        _, guarded = pre_discovery_gate(args.build_dir)
        build_dir = Path(guarded['build_dir'])
        if args.discovery_json:
            discovery = strict_json(args.discovery_json.read_text())
        else:
            child = subprocess.run(['ctest', '--test-dir', str(build_dir), '-N', '--show-only=json-v1'],
                                   capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=60)
            discovery = strict_json(child.stdout)
        plan = select_tests(discovery, build_dir, args.allow_gpu_correctness)
        require(plan['build_metadata'] == guarded, 'build metadata changed during discovery')
        if args.output:
            dump_new(args.output, plan)
        print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print('selection error: ' + str(error), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Static, fail-closed gate for the reviewed flat CTest registry. Never runs CMake.

This is deliberately not a general CMake interpreter. Only literal generated
add_test/set_tests_properties declarations are supported. Includes, subdirectories,
hooks, control flow and new generator formats require a separate policy review.
"""
import hashlib
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat

from cpu_gpu_protocol import ROOT, require

HOOK_NAMES = {'CTestCustom.cmake', 'CTestCustom.ctest', 'CTestConfig.cmake'}
TOKEN = re.compile(r'"([^"\\\r\n]*)"|\[=\[([^\r\n]*?)\]=\]|([A-Za-z0-9_]+)')


def read_regular(path):
    """Reject symlinks/nonregular/unreadable files rather than interpreting them."""
    info = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and bool(info.st_mode & 0o444),
            'unreadable/nonregular build metadata: ' + str(path))
    require(info.st_size <= 1024*1024, 'oversized build metadata')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    require(not any(c in text for c in ['\x00', '\r', '${', '$ENV{', '$<']),
            'ambiguous/expanded build metadata: ' + str(path))
    return text, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def statements(text):
    """Accept the small literal grammar emitted by the reviewed generators."""
    result = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if line.startswith('#'):
            require(not line.startswith('#['), 'unreviewed bracket comment')
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(add_test|set_tests_properties)\((.*)\)', line)
        require(match is not None, 'unreviewed CTest statement (includes/subdirs/hooks forbidden)')
        tokens, cursor = [], 0
        arguments = match[2]
        while cursor < len(arguments):
            if arguments[cursor].isspace():
                cursor += 1
                continue
            token = TOKEN.match(arguments, cursor)
            require(token is not None, 'malformed/ambiguous CTest argument')
            tokens.append(next(group for group in token.groups() if group is not None))
            cursor = token.end()
            require(cursor == len(arguments) or arguments[cursor].isspace(),
                    'ambiguous adjacent CTest arguments')
        result.append((match[1], tokens))
    return result


def expand(value, build):
    return value.replace('@source', str(ROOT.resolve())).replace('@build', str(build))


def validate_dart(path, build, policy):
    # DartConfiguration is key/value data, not CMake. Do not evaluate it. These
    # reviewed dashboard commands are not invoked by our fixed -N/-R commands.
    require(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode) and bool(path.stat().st_mode & 0o444),
            'unreadable/nonregular Dart configuration')
    require(path.stat().st_size <= 1024*1024, 'oversized Dart configuration')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    values = {}
    for line in raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict').splitlines():
        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*: [^\x00\r\n]*', line) is not None,
                'malformed Dart configuration')
        key, value = line.split(': ', 1)
        require(key not in values, 'duplicate Dart setting')
        values[key] = value
    expected = policy['dart_defaults']
    require(set(values) == set(expected), 'unknown/missing Dart setting')
    for key, value in values.items():
        if key in policy['dart_inert_metadata']:
            # These values are output-only environment labels, never commands.
            require(not any(c in value for c in [';', '$', '\\', '"']), 'ambiguous Dart label')
        elif key in ['ConfigureCommand', 'MakeCommand']:
            # Only an absolute cmake executable and the exact reviewed arguments.
            pattern = (r'"/[^";\s]+/cmake" "' + re.escape(str(ROOT.resolve())) + r'"'
                       if key == 'ConfigureCommand' else
                       r'/[^";\s]+/cmake --build \. --config "\$\{CTEST_CONFIGURATION_TYPE\}"')
            require(re.fullmatch(pattern, value) is not None, 'unreviewed Dart command: ' + key)
        elif key == 'DefaultCTestConfigurationType':
            require(value in ['Release', 'Debug'], 'unreviewed build configuration')
        else:
            require(value == expand(expected[key], build), 'modified Dart setting: ' + key)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def validate_build_tree(build_dir, manifest, expected_command):
    """Return a fingerprint only after all reachable CTest metadata is classified.

    The project registers all tests at the root. Reject nested test files and all
    includes/subdirs instead of attempting to evaluate arbitrary CMake programs.
    Scan the whole tree for directory hooks, including unreachable nested hooks.
    """
    build = Path(build_dir).absolute()
    require(build == build.resolve() and build.is_dir(), 'missing/aliased build directory')
    for component in [build, *build.parents]:
        require(not component.is_symlink(), 'symlinked build directory')
    require(not any(k.startswith('CTEST_') for k in os.environ), 'unreviewed CTEST environment override')
    policy = manifest.get('build_metadata')
    require(isinstance(policy, dict) and policy.get('policy') == 'flat_literal_ctest_v1',
            'missing reviewed build-metadata policy')
    files = {}
    def onerror(error):
        raise ValueError('unreadable build tree: ' + str(error)) from error
    for directory, dirs, names in os.walk(build, followlinks=False, onerror=onerror):
        parent = Path(directory)
        require(bool(parent.stat().st_mode & 0o444) and bool(parent.stat().st_mode & 0o111),
                'unreadable build directory')
        for name in dirs + names:
            path = parent/name
            require(not path.is_symlink(), 'unreviewed build symlink: ' + str(path))
            require(name not in HOOK_NAMES and not name.endswith('.ctest'),
                    'unreviewed CTest hook/configuration: ' + str(path))
            if name in ['CTestTestfile.cmake', 'DartConfiguration.tcl']:
                require(parent == build and name in names, 'unreviewed nested CTest metadata: ' + str(path))
    testfile = build/'CTestTestfile.cmake'
    text, digest = read_regular(testfile)
    files['CTestTestfile.cmake'] = digest
    declarations, properties = {}, {}
    for command, args in statements(text):
        require(bool(args), 'empty CTest declaration')
        name = args[0]
        require(name in manifest['tests'], 'unreviewed CTest test name')
        if command == 'add_test':
            require(name not in declarations and name not in properties, 'duplicate/out-of-order CTest declaration')
            require([str(Path(a).resolve()) for a in args[1:]] == expected_command(manifest['tests'][name]['command'], build),
                    'unreviewed generated command: ' + name)
            declarations[name] = args[1:]
        else:
            require(name in declarations and name not in properties and len(args) >= 4 and args[1] == 'PROPERTIES'
                    and len(args) % 2 == 0, 'malformed/duplicate CTest properties')
            pairs = dict(zip(args[2::2], args[3::2]))
            require(len(pairs) == (len(args)-2)//2, 'duplicate CTest property')
            expected = policy['test_properties'].get(name)
            require(isinstance(expected, dict) and pairs == {k: expand(v, build) for k,v in expected.items()},
                    'unreviewed generated properties/hooks/fixtures: ' + name)
            properties[name] = pairs
    names = set(declarations)
    cpu = set(manifest['cpu_build_tests']); gpu = set(manifest['cuda_additional_tests'])
    require(names in [cpu, cpu | gpu] and set(properties) == names, 'incomplete/unreviewed generated registry')
    dart = build/'DartConfiguration.tcl'
    if dart.exists():
        files[dart.name] = validate_dart(dart, build, policy)
    return dict(policy=policy['policy'], build_dir=str(build), files_sha256=files,
                test_names=sorted(names), commands=declarations, properties=properties)

            if args.prerequisites_only:

            else:
                result=call('cpu_sanitize_ctest_no_leaks',prefix+['ctest','--test-dir',str(san),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
            records['cpu_sanitize_ctest']=records['cpu_sanitize_ctest_no_leaks']

            '-DMAB_ENABLE_CPU_GPU_COMPARISON=ON','-DMAB_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=OFF','-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75',
            '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS=','-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O3 -DNDEBUG'])

        dump_new(output/'dependency_sha256.json',dict(include_root=str(include),files=dependency))

        correctness=call('cuda_correctness',[str(gpu/'test_cuda_sorting')],240)
        result=verify_result(json.loads(correctness['stdout']))
        if args.prerequisites_only:
            ctest=selected_ctest(call,output,'cuda_ctest',gpu,allow_gpu=True)
        else:
            ctest=call('cuda_ctest',['ctest','--test-dir',str(gpu),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
            require('0 tests failed out of 32' in ctest['stdout'] and '***Skipped' not in ctest['stdout'],'CUDA regression group skipped/missing')
            require('Ran 14 tests' in ctest['stdout'],'GPU framework coverage absent')

        prereq=dict(schema_version=1,protocol=PROTOCOL,complete=True,records=records,source_sha256=after['current_source_sha256'],
                    binary_sha256=sha(gpu/'cpu_gpu_comparison'),input_tool_sha256=sha(gpu/'comparison_input'),
                    cuda_correctness=result,preflight_sha256=sha(output/'preflight/report.json'),dependency_manifest_sha256=sha(output/'dependency_sha256.json'),
                    validation_scope='non_timing_correctness_v1' if args.prerequisites_only else 'full_protocol_v1',
                    study_eligible=not args.prerequisites_only)
        dump_new(output/'PREREQUISITES.json',prereq)

            dump_new(output/'COMPLETE.json',dict(complete=True,prerequisites_passed=True,pilot_run=False,full_study_run=False,
                validation_scope='non_timing_correctness_v1',study_eligible=False))
            return 0
        call('pilot',[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/run_cpu_gpu_pilot.py'),'--output',str(args.pilot_output.absolute()),
             '--executable',str(gpu/'cpu_gpu_comparison'),'--input-tool',str(gpu/'comparison_input'),
             '--prerequisites',str(output/'PREREQUISITES.json')],420)
        args.processed.absolute().mkdir()
        first=args.processed.absolute()/'summary.json';second=args.processed.absolute()/'summary_regenerated.json'
        for name,path in [('analyze',first),('regenerate',second)]:
            call(name,[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/analyze_cpu_gpu.py'),str(args.pilot_output.absolute()),'--output',str(path)])
        require(first.read_bytes()==second.read_bytes(),'summary regeneration differs')
        raw=args.pilot_output.absolute();manifest=json.loads((raw/'RAW_SHA256.json').read_text())
        require(all(sha(raw/p)==h for p,h in manifest.items()),'raw changed during analysis')
        load_protocol();require(verify_source_extension(model)==before,'source changed during pilot')
        dump_new(output/'COMPLETE.json',dict(complete=True,pilot_passed=True,full_study_run=False,measured=150,warmups=30,
                 summary_sha256=sha(first),summary_regenerated_identically=True,source_unchanged=True))

    except KeyboardInterrupt:

void secondary(cudaError_t status) noexcept {
    if (status != cudaSuccess) std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA timing cleanup: %s\n", cudaGetErrorString(status));

struct CudaTimingSession::Impl {
    CudaTimingInfo info;
    std::size_t size = 0, bytes = 0;
    Key *host_input = nullptr, *host_output = nullptr, *input = nullptr, *output = nullptr;
    void* workspace = nullptr;
    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
    std::array<cudaEvent_t, 4> events{};
    bool closed = false;
    ~Impl() noexcept {
        if (stream) secondary(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));
        for (auto e : events) if (e) secondary(cudaEventDestroy(e));
        if (workspace) secondary(cudaFree(workspace));
        if (output) secondary(cudaFree(output));
        if (input) secondary(cudaFree(input));
        if (host_output) secondary(cudaFreeHost(host_output));
        if (host_input) secondary(cudaFreeHost(host_input));
        if (stream) secondary(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));
    }
    void init(std::size_t n, std::size_t memory_limit_mib) {
        if (n > 1000000 || memory_limit_mib == 0 || memory_limit_mib > 65536)
            throw std::invalid_argument("CUDA timing size/limit outside milestone bounds");
        size = n; bytes = n * sizeof(Key);
        const auto limit = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(memory_limit_mib) * 1024 * 1024;
        if (bytes > limit / 5) throw std::invalid_argument("host payload budget exceeded");
        checked(cudaGetDevice(&info.device), "get device");
        cudaDeviceProp prop{};
        checked(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, info.device), "device properties");
        info.device_name = prop.name; info.compute_major = prop.major; info.compute_minor = prop.minor;
        info.device_memory_bytes = prop.totalGlobalMem;
        checked(cudaRuntimeGetVersion(&info.runtime_version), "runtime version");
        checked(cudaDriverGetVersion(&info.driver_version), "driver version");
        if (size < 2) return;
        std::size_t available = 0, total = 0;
        checked(cudaMemGetInfo(&available, &total), "device free memory");
        if (bytes > available / 4) throw std::runtime_error("device keys exceed half free memory");
        checked(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking), "create private stream");
        for (auto& event : events) checked(cudaEventCreate(&event), "create timing event");
        checked(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&host_input), bytes), "allocate pinned input");
        checked(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&host_output), bytes), "allocate pinned output");
        checked(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&input), bytes), "allocate device input");
        checked(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&output), bytes), "allocate device output");
        checked(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(nullptr, info.workspace_bytes, input, output,
                static_cast<int>(size), 0, 32, stream), "workspace sizing");
        if (2 * bytes > limit || info.workspace_bytes > limit - 2 * bytes ||
            2 * bytes > available / 2 || info.workspace_bytes > available / 2 - 2 * bytes)
            throw std::runtime_error("CUDA workspace exceeds device budget");
        checked(cudaMalloc(&workspace, info.workspace_bytes ? info.workspace_bytes : 1), "allocate workspace");
    }
};
CudaTimingSession::CudaTimingSession(std::size_t n, std::size_t limit)
    : impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()) { impl_->init(n, limit); }
CudaTimingSession::~CudaTimingSession() = default;
const CudaTimingInfo& CudaTimingSession::info() const noexcept { return impl_->info; }
CudaTimingSample CudaTimingSession::sample(const Values& input, Values& output) {
    auto& s = *impl_;
    if (s.closed || input.size() != s.size || output.size() != s.size || &input == &output)
        throw std::invalid_argument("invalid prepared CUDA timing buffers/session");
    using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    static_assert(Clock::is_steady, "monotonic host timer required");
    CudaTimingSample result;
    if (s.size < 2) {
        const auto start = Clock::now();
        if (s.size) output[0] = input[0];
        const auto stop = Clock::now();
        result.end_to_end_ns = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(stop - start).count());
        return result;
    }
    std::copy(input.begin(), input.end(), s.host_input);
    checked(cudaStreamSynchronize(s.stream), "prior stream synchronize");
    const auto start = Clock::now();
    checked(cudaEventRecord(s.events[0], s.stream), "record H2D start");
    checked(cudaMemcpyAsync(s.input, s.host_input, s.bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s.stream), "H2D");
    checked(cudaEventRecord(s.events[1], s.stream), "record sort start");
    checked(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(s.workspace, s.info.workspace_bytes, s.input, s.output,
            static_cast<int>(s.size), 0, 32, s.stream), "CUB SortKeys");
    checked(cudaGetLastError(), "CUB launch status");
    checked(cudaEventRecord(s.events[2], s.stream), "record D2H start");
    checked(cudaMemcpyAsync(s.host_output, s.output, s.bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s.stream), "D2H");
    checked(cudaEventRecord(s.events[3], s.stream), "record D2H stop");
    checked(cudaEventSynchronize(s.events[3]), "pipeline completion");
    const auto stop = Clock::now();
    const auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(stop - start).count();
    if (elapsed < 0) throw std::runtime_error("negative host duration");
    result.end_to_end_ns = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(elapsed);
    std::array<double*, 3> metrics{{&result.h2d_ns, &result.device_sort_ns, &result.d2h_ns}};
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < metrics.size(); ++i) {
        float ms = 0;
        checked(cudaEventElapsedTime(&ms, s.events[i], s.events[i + 1]), "event elapsed time");
        if (!std::isfinite(ms) || ms < 0) throw std::runtime_error("invalid event duration");
        *metrics[i] = static_cast<double>(ms) * 1000000.0;
    }
    std::copy(s.host_output, s.host_output + s.size, output.begin());
    return result;
}
void CudaTimingSession::close() {
    auto& s = *impl_;
    if (s.closed) return;
    if (s.stream) checked(cudaStreamSynchronize(s.stream), "close synchronize");
    for (auto& event : s.events) if (event) {
        const auto e = event; event = nullptr; checked(cudaEventDestroy(e), "destroy event");
    }
    auto release_device = [](auto*& pointer) {
        if (pointer) { auto* value = pointer; pointer = nullptr; checked(cudaFree(value), "free device buffer"); }
    };
    release_device(s.workspace); release_device(s.output); release_device(s.input);
    for (auto** p : {&s.host_output, &s.host_input})
        if (*p) { auto* value = *p; *p = nullptr; checked(cudaFreeHost(value), "free pinned buffer"); }
    if (s.stream) { const auto stream = s.stream; s.stream = nullptr; checked(cudaStreamDestroy(stream), "destroy stream"); }
    s.closed = true;
}

    if (n < 2 || n > 1000000) throw std::invalid_argument("resource diagnostic size outside [2,1M]");
    CudaComparisonResources result;
    int device=0; cudaDeviceProp prop{};
    check(cudaGetDevice(&device),"diagnostic get device");
    check(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop,device),"diagnostic device properties");
    result.gpu_name=prop.name; result.compute_major=prop.major; result.compute_minor=prop.minor;
    if (result.gpu_name!="Tesla T4" || prop.major!=7 || prop.minor!=5)
        throw std::runtime_error("frozen pilot requires Tesla T4 compute7.5");
    check(cudaRuntimeGetVersion(&result.runtime_version),"diagnostic runtime version");
    check(cudaDriverGetVersion(&result.driver_version),"diagnostic driver version");
    synchronize_comparison_device();
    check(cudaMemGetInfo(&result.free_device_bytes,&result.total_device_bytes),"diagnostic free memory");
    if (16*n > result.free_device_bytes/2) throw std::runtime_error("insufficient device key-buffer headroom");
    Buffer input, output, prepared_workspace, adapter_workspace;
    input.allocate(4*n); output.allocate(4*n);
    auto* in=static_cast<std::int32_t*>(input.pointer); auto* out=static_cast<std::int32_t*>(output.pointer);
    Stream stream; check(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&stream.value,cudaStreamNonBlocking),"diagnostic create stream");
    check(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(nullptr,result.adapter_query_bytes,in,out,static_cast<int>(n),0,32),"default-stream workspace query");
    check(cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortKeys(nullptr,result.prepared_query_bytes,in,out,static_cast<int>(n),0,32,stream.value),"private-stream workspace query");
    constexpr std::size_t cap=64*1024*1024;
    if (result.adapter_query_bytes>cap || result.prepared_query_bytes>cap)
        throw std::runtime_error("workspace exceeds frozen 64MiB cap: adapter="+std::to_string(result.adapter_query_bytes)+" prepared="+std::to_string(result.prepared_query_bytes));
    result.adapter_diagnostic_allocation_bytes=std::max(result.adapter_query_bytes,std::size_t{1});

    if (peak>256*1024*1024 || peak>result.free_device_bytes/2) throw std::runtime_error("combined frozen device budget exceeded");

namespace mab::detail {
struct NoParallelObserver {
    void task(std::size_t, std::size_t) const noexcept {}
    void merge(std::size_t, std::size_t, std::size_t) const noexcept {}
};
struct ParallelKeyLess {
    bool operator()(Key a, Key b) const noexcept { return a < b; }
};
template<class Less, class Observer>
void merge_range(Values& values, Values& buffer, std::size_t begin,
                 std::size_t middle, std::size_t end, Less less, Observer observer) noexcept {
    observer.merge(begin, middle, end);
    auto left=begin, right=middle, out=begin;
    while (left<middle && right<end) {
        if (less(values[right], values[left])) buffer[out++]=values[right++];
        else buffer[out++]=values[left++];
    }
    while (left<middle) buffer[out++]=values[left++];
    while (right<end) buffer[out++]=values[right++];
    std::copy(buffer.begin()+begin, buffer.begin()+end, values.begin()+begin);
}
template<class Less, class Observer>
void serial_range(Values& values, Values& buffer, std::size_t begin,
                  std::size_t end, Less less, Observer observer) noexcept {
    const auto size=end-begin;
    for (std::size_t width=1; width<size;) {
        for (auto first=begin; first<end;) {
            const auto middle=first+std::min(width,end-first);
            const auto last=middle+std::min(width,end-middle);
            merge_range(values,buffer,first,middle,last,less,observer);
            first=last;
        }
        if (width>=size-width) break;
        width*=2;
    }
}
template<class Less, class Observer>
void task_range(Values& values, Values& buffer, std::size_t begin,
                std::size_t end, Less less, Observer observer) noexcept {
    if (end-begin<=parallel_merge_grain) {
        serial_range(values,buffer,begin,end,less,observer);
        return;
    }
    const auto middle=begin+(end-begin)/2;
    #pragma omp task default(none) shared(values,buffer) firstprivate(begin,middle,less,observer)
    {
        observer.task(begin,middle);
        task_range(values,buffer,begin,middle,less,observer);
    }
    #pragma omp task default(none) shared(values,buffer) firstprivate(middle,end,less,observer)
    {
        observer.task(middle,end);
        task_range(values,buffer,middle,end,less,observer);
    }
    #pragma omp taskwait
    merge_range(values,buffer,begin,middle,end,less,observer);
}
template<class Less=ParallelKeyLess, class Observer=NoParallelObserver>
ParallelSortInfo parallel_merge_sort_impl(Values& values, int threads,
                                          Less less=Less{}, Observer observer=Observer{}) {
    static_assert(std::is_nothrow_invocable_r_v<bool,Less,Key,Key>);
    static_assert(std::is_nothrow_copy_constructible_v<Less> && std::is_nothrow_copy_constructible_v<Observer>);
    static_assert(noexcept(observer.task(0,0)) && noexcept(observer.merge(0,0,0)));
    if (threads<1 || threads>64) throw std::invalid_argument("threads must be in [1,64]");
    if (omp_get_level()>0) throw std::invalid_argument("nested OpenMP sorting is unsupported");
    if (values.size()<2) return {};
    Values buffer(values.size()); // All user allocation happens before tasks/mutation.
    if (threads==1 || values.size()<parallel_merge_threshold) {
        serial_range(values,buffer,0,values.size(),less,observer);
        return {};
    }
    int actual=1;
    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(threads) default(none) shared(values,buffer,actual) firstprivate(less,observer)
    {
        #pragma omp single
        {
            actual=omp_get_num_threads();
            task_range(values,buffer,0,values.size(),less,observer);
        }
    }
    return {actual,true};
}
} // namespace mab::detail
